title: Conditional Mean Flows: Few-Step Densities for Simulation-Based Inference
abstract: arXiv:2610.21657v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Flow matching has emerged as a powerful generative family for simulation-based inference (SBI). However, sampling and density evaluation require numerical integration at inference time. This makes posterior sampling in neural posterior estimation costly. More importantly, it can make repeated likelihood evaluation prohibitively expensive and impractical for Markov chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) sampling, which may require thousands of repeated density evaluations. Here, we develop conditional mean flows for posterior and likelihood approximation, combining few-step sampling with tractable density evaluation. We show that the mean flow objective identifies conditional flow maps and that independent masking enables direct estimation of marginal likelihoods. translated_title: 条件均值流：面向基于模拟推断的少步数密度估计
translated_abstract: 流匹配已成为基于模拟推断（SBI）中一类强大的生成模型族。然而，其采样和密度评估在推断阶段需要数值积分，这使得神经后验估计中的后验采样代价高昂。更重要的是，它会使重复的似然评估变得极其昂贵，对马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛（MCMC）采样而言不切实际，因为MCMC可能需要数千次重复的密度评估。在此，我们开发了用于后验和似然近似的条件均值流，将少步采样与可处理的密度评估相结合。我们证明均值流目标能够识别条件流映射，且独立掩码机制可直接估计边际似然。我们在多个任务上对后验估计和似然估计进行了评估，结果表明条件均值流在显著降低计算成本的同时，保留了基于流的密度估计器的灵活性。
tldr: 提出条件均值流方法，将少步采样与可解析的密度评估相结合，大幅降低了基于模拟推断中后验采样及MCMC重复似然评估的计算成本。
en_tdlr: Conditional mean flows combine few-step sampling with tractable density evaluation, dramatically reducing the cost of posterior sampling and repeated likelihood evaluations in simulation-based inference and MCMC.
